div_prob_3y.label: Recent Dividend Habit (3 yrs)
div_prob_3y.description: The probability of the company paying a dividend based purely on its track record over the last 3 years. A value of 1.0 means they paid every year.

components.definition: Dividend Status for a specific year (1 if paid, 0 if not).
The rolling window size (checking the last 3 years).

prob_x_ROA.label: Profit-Backed Habit
prob_x_ROA.description: A 'Quality Check' feature. It identifies companies that are BOTH historically reliable dividend payers AND are currently profitable. It filters out companies that pay dividends despite losing money.

components.definition: The calculated probability of paying based on history.
Return on Assets (Current Profitability).

prob_x_CurrentRatio.label: Cash-Backed Habit
prob_x_CurrentRatio.description: A 'Safety Check' feature. It identifies companies that are historically reliable dividend payers AND have the liquid cash on hand to pay this year.

components.definition: The calculated probability of paying based on history.
Liquidity metric showing ability to pay short-term obligations.

ROA.label: Return on Assets (ROA)
ROA.description: Measures how efficiently the management is using the company's total asset base to generate net profit.

components.definition: The actual profit after taxes and expenses.
Used here as Total Assets (Sum of Current + Non-Current Assets).

current_ratio.label: Liquidity (Current Ratio)
current_ratio.description: Can the company pay its short-term bills? A ratio above 1.0 means they have more liquid assets than immediate debts.

components.definition: Assets convertible to cash within one year (Cash, Inventory).
Debts due within one year.

asset_turnover.label: Sales Velocity
asset_turnover.description: How much revenue the company generates for every dollar of assets it owns. Higher is better.

components.definition: Total sales generated by the company.
Total Assets.

efficiency_score.label: Operational Efficiency
efficiency_score.description: A composite score combining how fast they sell products (Turnover) with their ability to pay bills (Liquidity).

components.definition: Speed of sales generation.
Short-term financial health.

ROA_x_leverage.label: Safe Profitability
ROA_x_leverage.description: Profitability score adjusted for risk. It penalizes companies that are profitable only because they are heavily relying on long-term debt.

components.definition: Return on Assets.
Non-Current Liabilities divided by Net Assets.

non_current_to_total_assets.label: Long-Term Asset Heaviness
non_current_to_total_assets.description: The portion of the company tied up in 'hard' assets (like buildings/machinery) which cannot be easily converted to cash for dividends.

components.definition: Property, Plant, Equipment and other long-term investments.
Total Assets.

asset_growth.label: Company Growth Rate
asset_growth.description: How fast the company is expanding its asset base compared to last year. Very high growth often consumes cash, leaving less for dividends.

components.definition: Total Assets in the current year.
Total Assets in the previous year.

ROA_lag1.label: Previous Year Profitability
ROA_lag1.description: The Return on Assets (ROA) from the previous year. Used to spot consistency or trends in profit.

profit_margin_lag1.label: Previous Year Margin
profit_margin_lag1.description: The Net Profit Margin from the previous year.

components.definition: Bottom line profit.

debt_to_assets_lag1.label: Previous Year Debt Load
debt_to_assets_lag1.description: The Long-Term Debt level of the company in the previous year. High past debt often restricts current dividends.

components.definition: Long-term financial obligations (loans, bonds).
